description: The AAO filter set catalogs optical broad-band and narrow-band filters historically offered for CCD direct imaging and focal plane instruments at the Anglo-Australian Telescope (AAT).
short_description: Anglo-Australian Telescope broad- and narrow-band filters (AAO)
facility_description: The Anglo-Australian Telescope (AAT) is a 3.9-meter equatorially mounted optical telescope at Siding Spring Observatory in New South Wales, operated by the Australian National University (ANU).
notes: AAO filters originate from the AAO Master Filter Catalog for the 3.9m Anglo-Australian Telescope at Siding Spring Observatory. Operation of the AAT was transferred to the Australian National University (ANU). Terms follow ANU website copyright policy restricting reproduction without permission.
